rows.role_title: State President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Proclamation No. 177, 1989, fixing 1 October 1989 for the commencement of the Police Third Amendment Act, 1989, was given at Pretoria on 28 September 1989 and signed by F. W. de Klerk as State President, no longer Acting, by order of the State President-in-Cabinet (countersigned A. J. Vlok).
